title: IntoIterator
concept: IntoIterator converts a type INTO an iterator — enabling for..in loops on any type implementing this interface.
why: for..in is the most natural way to iterate. IntoIterator makes ANY collection support it — not just built-in types.
tips: Implement IntoIterator to make your custom collections work with for..in
Use into_iter() for consuming iteration, iter() for borrowing, iter_mut() for mutable
Each collection typically has 3 IntoIterator implementations: for &Type, &mut Type, and Type
for..in is the most idiomatic way to iterate in XIOM
common_mistakes: Confusing IntoIterator (convert to iterator) with Iterator (be an iterator)
Forgetting that for..in CONSUMES the collection unless you borrow
Implementing IntoIterator but forgetting the associated types
